document_purpose: LLM-readable site framework for the 9 Muse Customs website. This file describes the current branding, SEO direction, layout system, CSS logic, media treatment, interaction patterns, and extension rules so another model can expand the site with additional content while preserving its design language.

implementation_stack.styling: CSS Modules plus global CSS token bridge

site_identity.category: custom automotive performance and luxury build studio
site_identity.core_offer: Premium custom performance builds with carbon aero, leather trim, signature red accents, and a concierge-style build request path.

avoid: fluffy luxury cliches without product detail
preferred_copy_shape: supporting paragraph with craftsmanship and material specificity

current_metadata.title: 9MUSE Premium Wireframe
current_metadata.description: Premium red, black, and silver responsive product wireframe with media placeholders.

recommended_brand_metadata.title_pattern: 9 Muse Customs | Premium Carbon, Leather, and Performance Builds
recommended_brand_metadata.meta_description_pattern: 9 Muse Customs creates premium custom automotive builds with carbon aero, tailored leather interiors, signature red accents, and a private inquiry-led process.

content_strategy.homepage_role: Brand-first cinematic landing page that introduces materials, craftsmanship, visual proof, and a premium inquiry path.
future_expandable_content_types: service pages for aero, interior, exterior, and concept packages

structured_data_recommendations: LocalBusiness or AutomotiveBusiness schema if address and service area exist
VideoObject schema for hero or featured films if hosted media metadata is available
ImageObject coverage for major gallery or case-study assets
FAQPage schema only if real FAQ content is added

visual_system.design_intent: The site should feel like a premium automotive atelier: dark metal, carbon weave, leather trim, cinematic imagery, and a restrained but aggressive red accent system.

light_mode.mood: silver, clean, technical, high-end studio lighting
light_mode.base_surface_direction: light silver and white surfaces with dark ink text and red accents

dark_mode.mood: black, carbon, leather, cinematic, high-contrast luxury
dark_mode.base_surface_direction: near-black layered surfaces with silver text hierarchy and red accent contrast

materials_language.carbon: cold, technical, exterior-focused, used for aero and performance storytelling
materials_language.leather: warm, tactile, interior-focused, used for upholstery and concierge luxury storytelling
materials_language.alternation_rule: Adjacent page folds should alternate between carbon-led and leather-led visual cues so the page does not become flat or repetitive.

image_treatment: grey multiply or dark overlay for legibility when text sits on top
high contrast but not cartoonishly oversaturated
avoid: generic abstract backgrounds in place of real vehicles

styling_architecture.global_layer: src/app/globals.css bridges theme tokens into CSS custom properties used by Tailwind and global base styles.
styling_architecture.page_layer: PremiumWireframe.module.css owns most of the final visual identity for the homepage.
styling_architecture.theme_provider: ThemeRootProvider injects theme and style variables via data attributes on the document element.

shape_system.usage_rule: Panels, media frames, controls, navigation chips, and overlays all inherit from the shared radius variables so the whole site changes as one system.

surface_pattern.base_surface_formula: Most cards and tool surfaces combine a translucent or mixed gradient layer with a texture image and a border line.
common_surface_characteristics: backdrop blur where floating or over media

background_logic.global_page: Gradient-driven page background with a subtle repeating technical line pattern.
background_logic.dark_mode_global: Dark gradient plus carbon texture at the page level.
background_logic.section_folds: Folds use either carbon texture or leather texture depending on material intent.
background_logic.parallax_fold: Leather fold uses fixed background attachment on large screens and falls back to scroll on small screens.

contrast_rules: All headline-on-media sections require a dark scrim or multiply overlay.
Dark mode body copy should lean toward silver-grey rather than pure white for hierarchy.
Red is reserved for emphasis and control activation, not large body text blocks.
Glass and overlay surfaces still need explicit text color declarations for both themes.

layout_framework.page_width: Most content bands constrain to 1480px max width with responsive inner padding.

navigation_pattern.header: sticky branded header with logo, nav links, and a right-side CTA
navigation_pattern.subnav: secondary sticky anchor bar just below header

section_order.purpose: brand statement and cinematic first impression
conversion panel plus build preferences card

section_composition_rules: Alternate dense dark folds and lighter technical folds for rhythm.
Use wide full-width section bands rather than stacking many small centered cards.
Keep major imagery at section scale, not tiny thumbnails.
When a section has copy and media, the layout should usually be split into a copy column and a media object column.

expansion_rules: Keep the H1 concise and brand-led.
Keep the supporting paragraph under roughly three sentences.
If additional proof is needed, use compact stat cards or micro-badges rather than cluttering the hero.

stat_cards.shape: three-card band with icon, large value, small label

chapter_split_section.role: Explain one core brand dimension beside a strong image.
chapter_split_section.layout: copy on one side, framed image on the other

material_panels.role: Material storytelling blocks with imagery and overlays
required_features: headline and paragraph anchored over media

motion_section.role: Feature a hero film or campaign video as a premium object, not just a plain embed.
behavior: display a still frame or thumbnail card
open the YouTube video in a lightbox dialog

gallery_grid.pattern: asymmetrical image matrix with one emphasized larger item
rules: every image tile should have a readable label chip
maintain object-fit cover and a strong dark bottom gradient for labels

floating_toolbox.role: Display controls without occupying primary header space

theme_switching.default_behavior: The theme provider defaults to dark mode while still supporting system resolution.
theme_switching.page_expectation: Both themes should preserve the same layout and brand hierarchy, not become two different designs.

radius_switching.user_value: Lets the same premium layout feel sharper or softer without changing overall composition.

video_behavior.hero: Autoplaying muted YouTube background video used for atmosphere.
video_behavior.chapter_media: Still video poster presented as a clickable premium media object.
video_behavior.lightbox: Video opens in modal/lightbox rather than taking the user away to YouTube.

existing_patterns: aria labels on landmark sections and nav
keyboard close behavior for lightbox via Escape
future_rules: preserve strong contrast on text over media
ensure CTA buttons remain keyboard reachable
do not rely on texture alone for distinction

default_section_template.headline: bold premium claim with material or build specificity
default_section_template.body: 1 to 3 concise sentences grounded in craftsmanship, materials, process, or outcomes
default_section_template.supporting_media: image, video still, or gallery frame tied directly to the section claim
default_section_template.cta: only include when the section naturally leads to action

approved_content_directions: gallery chapters by angle or subsystem
expansion_rules: Preserve the carbon-versus-leather alternation across major folds.
Do not insert generic marketing sections that ignore the material language.
New sections should usually map to one visual mood: technical carbon, tactile leather, cinematic motion, or luxury consultation.
Keep large sections image-led; do not let text dominate the entire page without media support.
Use red sparingly as an accent, never as a full-page dominant wash.
When adding cards, keep the typography compact and structured for scanning.
When adding long-form content, break it into premium folds rather than one uninterrupted article block.
content_do_not_rules: Do not turn the site into a generic car dealer template.
Do not use pastel palettes or soft lifestyle-brand visuals.
Do not add oversized rounded cards everywhere unless the selected radius mode calls for it.
Do not replace real vehicle imagery with abstract graphics when proof imagery is available.
Do not overload the hero with too many messages, bullets, or logos.

llm_handoff_summary.what_this_site_is: A premium single-page automotive customization brand site built around cinematic media, carbon-versus-leather material storytelling, and a private inquiry path.
what_must_remain_true: Brand remains centered on 9 Muse Customs.
Color scheme remains red, black, and silver/grey.
Layout stays premium, image-forward, and high contrast.
Dark and light themes use the same structural system.
Section rhythm alternates technical and tactile material moods.
The site should feel like an atelier or custom build studio, not a generic commerce template.
llm_handoff_summary.how_to_expand: Add new content as branded folds or chapters that preserve the existing hierarchy: eyebrow, bold headline, concise proof-focused copy, premium media, and a controlled CTA when needed. Reuse existing color tokens, radius variables, media framing, and texture logic rather than inventing new design languages.
